Từ giả thiết ta có:\\
		$\sin x + \cos x = \displaystyle\frac{1}{2} \Leftrightarrow (\sin x + \cos x)^2 = \displaystyle\frac{1}{4} \Leftrightarrow 1 + 2\sin x \cos x = \displaystyle\frac{1}{4} \Leftrightarrow 2\sin x \cos x = -\displaystyle\frac{3}{4} \Leftrightarrow \sin 2x = -\displaystyle\frac{3}{4}$.\\
		Suy ra $A = \displaystyle\frac{1 + \sin 2x}{1 - \sin 2x} = \displaystyle\frac{1 - \displaystyle\frac{3}{4}}{1 + \displaystyle\frac{3}{4}} = \displaystyle\frac{\displaystyle\frac{1}{4}}{\displaystyle\frac{7}{4}} = \displaystyle\frac{1}{7}$.\\
		Vậy $a+b=8$.
